The almond measures ~512 px tip to tip, from (878,1397) to ~(1355,1590). Correcting for the almond's ~21 deg tilt or a slightly hidden left tip gives ~520-530 px. The bow/almond ratio is ~0.77-0.81 against 0.65 expected (15/23 mm), so each bow reads ~17.5-18.5 mm (+17-25%). A sharper re-run would make each bow about two-thirds of the almond.

Both bows render cleanly at phone size (430 px wide).

reasons: Scale: the bow is ~40% oversize against the ear. The ear runs from the helix top at y~501 to the lobe's lower edge at y~1077 (the red lobe skin between the tails ends there), so it is ~576 px tall. The bow spans x~1150-1353, ~203 px bezel to bezel, which is 0.35 of ear height. On a ~60 mm ear that is ~21 mm wide against the listed 15 mm. The expected width is 0.25 of ear height, ~145 px. The bow's height is also ~173 px (y955-1128), about 18 mm against ~12 mm real. The bow overhangs the whole lobe on both sides, where a 15 mm bow would sit inside it.

Face edge: a probable eyebrow tail shows at the right frame edge. A cluster of dark, denser hairs fans in from x~1790-1856, y~490-570. That is level with the top of the ear and ~55 mm in front of the tragus, exactly where the lateral brow tail sits in this near-profile view. The dark orbital hollow shadow sits directly below it at x~1820-1856, y~610-720. The worn-shot rule says any eyebrow, even at the edge, fails.
notes: The product itself is correct: 4 clear stones (2 pear loops pointing into the knot, 2 tapered tails), a ridged gold knot, thin wavy yellow-gold bezels and crystal tips at the loop ends.

Peach backdrop and peach silk top read as the apricot/peach camp.
fix: Regenerate at true scale. The bow should be about a quarter of the ear's height, ~15 mm wide by ~12 mm tall, sitting inside the lobe at about three-quarters of the lobe's width, with the tails not overhanging the lobe edges. Keep the same back three-quarter, ear-level framing, with the knot at the lobe piercing. Turn the head slightly further away, or frame tighter on the ear and neck, so the right edge stops behind the temple: no brow tail and no eye-socket shadow. The current plate's right edge would need to lose at least ~120 px.
